name: Send to Marvin
desc: Sends a page, chosen pages, a whole note, headings you mark, a lasso selection, or selected document text to Claude (Anthropic API) to extract to-dos, then adds them to your Amazing Marvin inbox. Uses your own Anthropic API key and Marvin API token, entered in the plugin's Settings and stored only on this device (MyStyle/SnMarvin/settings.note). Note images and text are sent to api.anthropic.com; task titles and notes are sent to serv.amazingmarvin.com. Nothing else leaves the device.
author: ddpedersen
